questions.question: Who returns to teach Potions so Snape can finally teach Defense Against the Dark Arts?
questions.note: Dumbledore pulls him out of retirement because Slughorn once taught Tom Riddle and has a memory Dumbledore needs.

questions.question: What is the potion called liquid luck?
questions.note: Slughorn offers a tiny bottle as a prize. Harry later uses it to get the real memory.

questions.question: What number does young Tom Riddle call the most powerfully magical?
questions.note: He wants his soul split into seven pieces. That is the plan behind the Horcruxes.

questions.question: What is a Horcrux?
questions.answer: An object hiding a piece of a soul
choices: An object hiding a piece of a soul
A wand that cannot lose a duel
A potion that restores a body
A spell that binds two wizards
questions.note: You make one by committing murder and splitting your soul. Destroy the object and that piece of soul is gone.

questions.question: What Horcrux left Dumbledore's hand blackened?
questions.note: He had already destroyed the ring by the time term started. The curse in it is killing him, and it shows in the hand.

questions.question: What creatures rise out of the underground lake when Dumbledore is too weak to hold them?
questions.note: Corpses reanimated to guard the basin. Fire drives them back. Dumbledore drinks the potion so Harry can reach the locket.

questions.question: What initials are signed on the note inside the fake locket?
questions.note: The note says the real Horcrux was stolen, and that the writer intends to destroy it. The films do not spell out the name behind the initials.

questions.question: What vow does Snape make to Narcissa Malfoy about Draco?
questions.note: Bellatrix binds it. Snape swears to watch over Draco and to finish Draco's task if Draco cannot.

questions.question: What curse from the Half-Blood Prince's textbook does Harry use on Draco?
questions.note: The margin says 'for enemies.' It slashes Draco open. Snape is the one who stops the bleeding.

questions.question: Who is the Half-Blood Prince?
questions.note: The old Potions book Harry trusts all year belonged to Snape. He claims the name on the tower.
